title: Battle of Carpintería
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Carpintería", at revision 1370436362, opens: "The Battle of Carpintería was an important battle between troops loyal to the government of Manuel Oribe and the revolutionary forces led by Fructuoso Rivera." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q3529812, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1836 battle in Uruguay". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
